## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter is still valid (`name: write-like-human`, description under 1024 characters)
- [ ] Any new module is linked from the right table in `SKILL.md`
- [ ] The module has the usual sections and one before and after example
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes anywhere
- [ ] No real personal data (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, documents)
- [ ] Follows the ethics rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Tested by uploading the zipped skill and trying a few everyday prompts
